{
"literal": "استعد للجسم الشاطئي هذا الصيف.",
"adaptation": "شكل صحي وصُمَم معدل لهذا الصيف في صالة الألعاب الرياضية لدينا.",
"back_translation": "Healthy shape and toned summer figure in our gym.",
"approach": "adapted",
"notes": "The original phrase 'get beach-body ready' implies a very specific physical appearance goal, which might not resonate culturally in Saudi Arabia. The adapted version shifts the focus to general health and well-being, which aligns better with local values."
}
adaptation: شكل صحي وصُمَم معدل لهذا الصيف في صالة الألعاب الرياضية لدينا.
back_translation: Healthy shape and toned summer figure in our gym.
notes: The original phrase 'get beach-body ready' implies a very specific physical appearance goal, which might not resonate culturally in Saudi Arabia. The adapted version shifts the focus to general health and well-being, which aligns better with local values.
